fieldValues.title: Write in paragraphs
fieldValues.summary: Your essay is a list of paragraphs. Each paragraph is kept on its own, so it can be linked, commented on and moved. Give a paragraph a short title when you know what it says. Each paragraph's text is written in markdown, a simple way to format text with plain characters. Click a paragraph to see it: type `**bold**` for bold, or `# Title` at the start of a line for a heading. The rest is under **Markdown help**.
